# GeoClick Capture 1.5.0 — Offline Gazetteer

GeoClick Capture can now search institutional and project-specific place lists without an Internet connection.

## Highlights

- New **Offline Gazetteer** tab beside Capture Log, Search & Capture and Match & Verify.
- Load UTF-8 or UTF-8-BOM CSV gazetteers.
- Use any point layer already open in QGIS, including GeoPackage and database-backed layers.
- Automatic detection of common columns for official names, aliases, P-codes, coordinates, place types and administrative names.
- Offline search across official names, alternative spellings and P-codes.
- Optional place-type filtering.
- Preview, zoom, Match & Verify and Add to session actions.
- Audit fields for gazetteer source, record ID, P-code, official name, aliases, type, administrative hierarchy and source date.
- Packaged CSV template for creating compatible institutional gazetteers.
- Four new SVG icons and pure-Python tests for loading, normalisation and search.

Search & Capture, Match & Verify, snapping, reverse geocoding, session management and CSV/GeoJSON/GeoPackage export remain available.
